name: Elmify
audience: Master's degree applicants in Azerbaijan and worldwide (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes)
Study-abroad agencies and educational counsellors in Baku and abroad
capabilities: Reads official university and scholarship regulations across 50+ countries in 40+ local languages for master's degrees with sentence-level source links
Evaluates student GPA across national grading scales, Bachelor's ECTS subject credits, IELTS/TOEFL/TestDaF scores, citizenship, and AZN/EUR/GBP/USD budgets against programme and funder rules

Groups matched master's programmes under the scholarship that funds them across both flagship national scholarships (Azerbaijan State Program Dövlət Proqramı 2022–2028, HTP / Stipendium Hungaricum, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Swedish Institute SISGP, Chevening, Fulbright, Türkiye Bursları, NL Scholarship) and 5 low-competition scholarship categories (automatic faculty waivers like French IdEx/LabEx, Italian regional DSU income-based grants, Visegrad/ADB-JSP regional bloc funds, local-language Stiftungen/vakıflar, and departmental RA/TA assistantships)

Generates tailored zero-fabrication academic CVs (German Tabular, Europass, and standard academic formats), programme-tailored motivation letters anchored to each department's faculty and courses, scholarship essays, and distinct referee talking-point briefs

Provides a glass-box browser extension co-pilot that autofills verified fields and attaches tailored PDFs on official portals (DreamApply, uni-assist, Studielink, and university portals) while stopping before the Submit button
Provides a white-label trilingual (AZ/EN/RU) multi-counsellor application management workspace for study-abroad agencies
